title: ProductFeature
description:
A product_feature represents an attachment between a feature and a product.
When a product is purchased that has a feature attached, Stripe will create an entitlement to the feature for the purchasing customer.

livemode.description: If the object exists in live mode, the value is `true`. If the object exists in test mode, the value is `false`.

object.description: String representing the object's type. Objects of the same type share the same value.
